notes.title: 2024-03-25 Major Update + BUG Fixed
notes.notes:
[b]Updated Content:[/b]
1. Added single-player game levels for "Sky Crossing Mining Vessel".
2. Implemented a function of showing unit/creation information during gameplay.
3. Implemented a feature to provide navigation route previews during deployment.

[b]Bug Fixed:[/b]
1. Optimized resource loading efficiency.
2. Fixed an issue where players couldn't simultaneously exit the game and return to an lobby when disconnecting without quitting the game.
3. Adjusted the size of the basic game window.
4. Improved the save mechanism.
5. Fixed the issue with friend avatar display.
6. Resolved the problem of target base not synchronizing updates during online games.
7. Fixed behavioral logic errors for some units.
8. Optimized network connection methods.
9. Improved resource utilization for pathfinding calculations when massive units are pathfinding simultaneously.

notes.title: 2024-03-03 BUG Fixed
notes.notes: 1. Fixed the issue where players were unable return to the lobby automatically when one player quit the battle without disconnecting.

notes.title: 2024-03-02 BUG Fixed
notes.notes:
1. Optimized network connection method.
2. Reduced resources used by network connections.
3. Fixed the issue where newly established deployment areas were not synchronously updated when units moved.
4. Fixed the issue where deployment areas were sometimes established in incorrect positions when units deployed.
5. Fixed the issue where the lobby friend list could not be updated in real-time in online rooms.

notes.title: 2024-03-01 BUG Fixed
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the issue where some units would disappear during moving.
2. Fixed sound issues with some units.
3. Fixed the image display issue for some units.
4. Fixed the issue where bases/creations would incorrectly recognize creations as blockable objects.
5. Fixed the issue of structures being obscured on high land.
6. Fixed the issue of some visual errors on the battlefield map.

notes.title: 2024-02-29 BUG Fixed
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the issue where Unit/Creation cards couldn't be used for deployment when mouse operations were performed just after their generation.
2. Fixed the issue where positions of corresponding units for both players would gradually drift when a large number of units were moving simultaneously.

notes.title: 2024-02-28 BUG Fixed
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the issue when the mouse position exceeded the map boundaries during deployment.
2. Fixed the issue where "Armed Fixer" mistakenly identified itself as a repair target.
3. Fixed the issue where some units were covered by the map.
4. Fixed the issue of spatial audio location.
5. Improved resource efficiency during unit pathfinding.
6. Made some adjustments to the game visuals.
